Sequel story to Final Fantasy IX, set after the conclusion of the main plot, focusing on the Friendly Nymph in her quest to revitalize and green the deserts of the Outer Continent.

Also has bonus story feaeturing Madam Lamia of Gizamaluke Grotto doing what she does best: soft-vore, but this time it is to help a needy soul (Friendly Nymph).
